Players Committee card image of [[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo) (V) (ALT) (Errata 2)]] (errata PC-E2), game text: “While aboard a starfighter, adds 2 to power, maneuver, and hyperspeed. While present with a Scomp link, adds one [Light Side] icon here and, during battles at same and related related interior sites, once per turn may use 1 Force to subtract 1 from a just drawn destiny.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/r2d2_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b 9d2c01e] (30 December 2024). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
